answer: Printers make names; they do not make pasts. Taxidermist licence with wildlife agency attestation is the past: two-year training, 300 supervised mounts, hygiene exam, licence renewed every two. The pigment is the witness list — every entry names a third party who can be asked, and none of them works for the applicant. One fake needs one complete past; a hundred need a hundred, and the whisper in the middle is the bill for all of them. The bridge is the ledger check, over in seconds.
